advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 11/12 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 1.00 / R 1.00; 5/6 stops locked both

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.503 over 12 corners (10 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 4403 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 2.55; 1/2 launches spun

advice.text: Launch wheelspin only in 1/2 launches — inconsistent (surface, temps or throttle?). Two more standing launches on the same surface.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.51) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
